thread:
incident-bot: PAGER -> Increased error rate observed for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1. Paging eng-oncall @sara. spike started 2026-03-17T14:07:00Z, error rate ~6% over baseline. alert link: https://alerts.redwood.example/ABCD1234 :rotating_light:

sara: I'm on it. Starting immediate routing to eu-fallback pool and enabling per-customer throttles. Will attach quick mitigation steps here.

mike: tagging in infra - I'll validate node health and NGINX upstreams. If redis is saturated we'll scale read replicas.

jen: drafting public notice now. Q for oncall — scope of customer impact? whole EU region or subset? need numbers for the page.

sara: current snapshot: ~2% of all embeddings requests in eu-west failing (502/504), ~0.8% are retries. Affected customers: a handful of high-throughput embedding jobs. No data exfiltration. Root cause unknown, likely request queueing + one overloaded serving shard.

gopal: copying a short public update draft below, please review.

```
Public update (Incident RWI-2026-0317-1)
Impact: Some customers in eu-west-1 may experience increased errors or longer latencies for embeddings (approx 2% of requests).
Scope: Embeddings endpoint (/v1/embeddings) only; other APIs unaffected.
Workaround: We have temporarily routed traffic to a fallback GPU pool and enabled per-customer throttles to stabilize throughput.
Mitigation in progress: engineering applied routing changes and are scaling serving capacity. Ongoing monitoring.
Estimated next update: in 20-30 minutes.
```

jen: looks good, add a line saying "no customer data lost" and link to status site. I'll prep publish when we confirm error drop. :thumbsup:

amanda: FYI ops playbook suggests adding a follow-up note about model-variant fallback (we used quantized-variant-v2) so customers understand potential slight quality delta.

sara: confirmed: routed to quantized-variant-v2 fallback for bulk jobs. Quality impact expected to be small; only applies to long-batch jobs.

mike: infra checks: one serving shard had elevated CPU and oom_kill traces around 14:01-14:05. I scaled the pool + rotated the node. Redis connection high-water cleared after scale.

sara: update @everyone — after routing and scale: error rate dropped to ~1.1% at 14:28. Still seeing intermittent 502s from older shard. Keeping throttles for now.

gopal: second public update draft:
```
Update (Incident RWI-2026-0317-1)
Current status: Mitigations (traffic routing, pool scale, throttles) in effect. Error rate reduced from ~6% to ~1.1%.
Customer impact: Reduced but ongoing transient errors for a small subset of heavy embedding jobs.
Next steps: Allow traffic to stabilize for 30m; continue scaling and drain the problematic shard.
```

jen: ok to publish this update. I'll post to the public notices page and add a link to the incident post.

amanda: quick reminder to add internal postmortem checklist item: "confirm if autoscaler thresholds need tuning for embedding hot tails"

sara: agreed. I'll keep monitoring. If errors drop under 0.5% and remain steady for 10m we'll start gradual rollback of throttles.

incident-bot: Incident RWI-2026-0317-1 — public update published at 2026-03-17T14:32:00Z: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/RWI-2026-0317-1

sara: 14:58 update — errors holding at ~0.4% after draining shard and removing one throttle. No new fail influx. Continuing to monitor for 20m.

mike: infra final check looks green. No further oom_kill traces; underlying nodes stable.

gopal: resolved notice draft:
```
Resolved (Incident RWI-2026-0317-1)
Summary: Mitigations including routing to fallback pool, scaling serving capacity, and draining an overloaded shard fully restored service.
Impact: Customers in eu-west-1 experienced increased errors for embeddings; errors are now back to baseline.
Customer action: None required. If you continue to see issues, please contact support with request ids.
Time resolved: 2026-03-17T15:05:00Z.
```

jen: I'm going to publish the resolved notice now. Great work team. :tada:

incident-bot: RESOLVED — Incident RWI-2026-0317-1 marked resolved at 2026-03-17T15:05:00Z. Postmortem needed.

sara: thanks everyone. I'll own the postmortem and follow up with a root cause hypothesis and remediation plan by EOD tomorrow.

jen: thanks — I'll close the public thread and attach links to the customer message archive.

mike: closing infra tickets, will link graphs.

amanda: adding follow-up actions to the internal ops checklist.

incident-bot: Thread archived and customer notification sequence completed.
